tools.name: apply_filter
tools.description: Select one canonical Webroom filter as an independent undoable layer. Manual adjustment values are preserved; use none to remove only the filter.

tools.name: crop_image
tools.description: Crop using whole-pixel x, y, width, and height in the current oriented image coordinates returned by get_document_info.

tools.name: export_image
tools.description: Export the current full-resolution edit as JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Delivery defaults to a local download; bounded data_url delivery returns image data.

tools.name: flip_image
tools.description: Flip the active image across its horizontal or vertical axis.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Get safe metadata for the active Webroom image, including source and current output pixel dimensions, revision, dirty state, and history counts.

tools.name: get_edit_history
tools.description: Get concise ordered edit history and redo entries. Returns command summaries and sources without pixel data.

tools.name: get_edit_state
tools.description: Get every manual adjustment, non-destructive geometry value, independently selected filter, and revision for the active image. Manual values are applied on top of the filter.

tools.name: get_image_preview
tools.description: Return an original or edited image preview as a bounded data URL. maxDimension is 64–2048 pixels and quality is 1–100.

variant.description: Whether to render the untouched source or current edit.

tools.name: open_image_from_data_url
tools.description: Open a JPEG, PNG, or WebP data URL up to 12 MiB encoded length. Set replace true only to discard unexported edits.

tools.name: open_image_from_url
tools.description: Open a JPEG, PNG, or WebP from an HTTPS URL using a CORS request without credentials. Set replace true only to discard unexported edits.

tools.name: redo_edit
tools.description: Redo one previously undone edit in the active Webroom document.

tools.name: reset_edits
tools.description: Reset all adjustments and geometry to the untouched source as one undoable command.

tools.name: resize_image
tools.description: Resize to positive whole-pixel dimensions. Supply width, height, or both; one omitted dimension preserves aspect ratio.

tools.name: rotate_image
tools.description: Rotate the active image by -90, 90, or 180 degrees. Positive values rotate clockwise.

tools.name: set_blacks
tools.description: Set the manual blacks layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_blur
tools.description: Set the manual blur layer to an absolute value from 0 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_brightness
tools.description: Set the manual brightness layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_contrast
tools.description: Set the manual contrast layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_exposure
tools.description: Set the manual exposure layer to an absolute value from -5 through 5. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_highlights
tools.description: Set the manual highlights layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_saturation
tools.description: Set the manual saturation layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_shadows
tools.description: Set the manual shadows layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_sharpening
tools.description: Set the manual sharpening layer to an absolute value from 0 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_temperature
tools.description: Set the manual temperature layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_tint
tools.description: Set the manual tint layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_vibrance
tools.description: Set the manual vibrance layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: set_whites
tools.description: Set the manual whites layer to an absolute value from -100 through 100. It is applied on top of the selected filter and creates one undoable edit.

tools.name: undo_edit
tools.description: Undo one committed human or agent edit in the active Webroom document.
